text: The following question stood in the name of  Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong –  9 To ask the Minister for Transport what are the plans for a zero-emissions transportation system in the new Jurong Innovation District and the existing Jurong industrial areas.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
text: First, we will sustain our efforts to make Walk-Cycle-Ride the preferred way to get around Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
text: This includes commuting via buses and trains, which are the cleanest and most sustainable forms of public transport.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
text: To support these goals, we will continue to invest in expanding and renewing our rail and cycling networks and take an integrated planning approach to promote Walk-Cycle-Ride.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
text: The rail network will also be complemented by a comprehensive public bus network and it will be supported by integrated transport hubs to encourage greater use of public transport.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Since 2020, all new public bus purchases have been fully electric or hybrid models.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Additionally, all new bus infrastructure, such as depots and interchanges, will be designed and built to support these cleaner energy buses.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
text: For private cars and motorcycles, growth rates have been capped at zero since 2018.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
text: To encourage the take-up of cleaner vehicles, we have a suite of measures to incentivise the adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) and we will be significantly expanding public EV charging infrastructure.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
text: JID and the Jurong industrial estate area are part of the Jurong West and Tengah towns, which are designed and designated to be EV-ready towns.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
text: For instance, the JRL's Tengah Depot will integrate solar panels, with the electricity generated helping to offset the power consumption of both the depot and the JRL.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Could I ask: I know we are making a lot of progress on EV buses and EV cars, but could we make similar progress on EV motorcycles as well?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: And I think that is one of the areas that is quite lacking here in Singapore.

speaker: Mr S Iswaran
text: In fact, there is another Parliamentary Question later on about EV adoption rates and we can go into it in more detail then.

speaker: Mr S Iswaran
text: But the short answer is, yes, we are looking at also what can be done in terms of EV motorcycles.

speaker: Mr S Iswaran
text: Some of the ideas being explored include swappable batteries and so on.

speaker: Mr S Iswaran
text: This, again, is an area of work that is being undertaken in consultation with the industry.
